properties.processing: Selected the complete source feature in EPSG:3067 and transformed to EPSG:4326. The marine boundary was topology-preserving simplified at 3 m in EPSG:3067 to limit detail response size. All 12 polygon parts and 1,718 holes were retained. WGS84 coordinates were rounded to eight decimals.
